subject: Issues with Transfer to New Time using EcoClimate

messages.author: 0f7fb7dc1777ce43
messages.subject: Issues with Transfer to New Time using EcoClimate
parts:
Hello,
I am new to using Wallace, but am trying to transfer my model to the past or future using EcoClimate. However, every time I try to do so, I get the error: ! ERROR : Please select transfer time period.

messages.author: 881c0dd9c7b0d196
messages.subject: Re: Issues with Transfer to New Time using EcoClimate
parts:
Hello,
Can you uninstall your current Wallace and install this version to see if this issue is still happening?

install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("bjohnso005/wallace@xfer_dev")
library(wallace)
run_wallace()

I think I corrected this issue and would love to know if it works!

-Bethany
